claims.content: Manage track identity classification by exchanging track identity data, reporting track identification data, and resolving identity differences received in track reports.

goal.raw_text: Manage track identity classification by exchanging track identity data, reporting track identification data, and resolving identity differences received in track reports.

claims.content: C2 JU
The source of track data is provided (Source TN).
The Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields are implemented by the C2 JU.
A track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1 is received.
The new identity is Friend and the locally held identity is not Hostile.
A track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1 is received.

trigger.raw_text: A track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1 is received.

claims.content: The C2 JU receives a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1.
The C2 JU determines whether there are any conflicts between locally derived information and information reported on the interface.
The C2 JU displays the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator to operators to give an extra measure of confidence in the track identification data being reported.
The C2 JU exchanges track identity as defined in paragraph 4.4.2.1.
The C2 JU reports the most current IFF/SIF data.

The C2 JU reports the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator in the J3 message as value 2 if all IFF/SIF nonzero mode codes were obtained from or are the same as the codes received in the J2 message for the subject TN; otherwise, if the Mode II code was obtained from or is the same as the Mode II code received in the J2 message, the C2 JU reports the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator as value 1; otherwise, the C2 JU reports the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator as value 0.

At main flow step 1, notwithstanding the requirements of paragraph 4.7.1.2.1 and 4.7.1.2.2, a C2 JU may elect to accept, automatically, changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1, provided the new identity is Friend and the locally held identity is not Hostile.
Multiple J7.3C1 words can be sent to accommodate more than five addresses.

When the J7.3 message is used to specify one or more operator positions by function within a JU through the use of the pointer action data element, there is no TN assigned to the pointer; therefore, it must be displayed and dropped by local procedure.
Track identity as defined in paragraph 4.4.2.1 is exchanged.
The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator is displayed to operators to give an extra measure of confidence in the track identification data being reported.
The most current IFF/SIF data is reported.

The PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator in the J3 message is reported as value 2 if all IFF/SIF nonzero mode codes were obtained from or are the same as the codes received in the J2 message for the subject TN; otherwise, if the Mode II code was obtained from or is the same as the Mode II code received in the J2 message, the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator is reported as value 1; otherwise, the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator is reported as value 0.

If the C2 JU elects to accept, changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1 are accepted automatically, provided the new identity is Friend and the locally held identity is not Hostile.
